verification.method: Read both local JSON files and inspect all seven changed chains. Parse with JSON.parse; compare recursively with node:util.isDeepStrictEqual. Remove only the four literal layout tokens from the current decoded displayAnswer strings, with no whitespace, punctuation, relation, command, brace, or numeric normalization, and compare to the untouched original strings.

This is an identity check, not a new assessment of the experiment or its source.

Fraction and subscript braces and ending commas/periods are unchanged. The intensity chain preserves 2I0(1+cos(delta)), 4I0 cos-squared(delta/2), all parentheses, the fraction, the negative thin-space command and 3.991I0. Exact-versus-approximate relations are unchanged. Geometry, exact path-difference and phase equations, the bright-but-not-exact-maximum explanation, 0.9978 ratio and 99.8 percent statement are identical. Every non-display field is identical.

The opening cm/m/nm values, grating-order equations, exact subtraction, small-angle relation, degree-to-radian conversion and English warnings about approximation, sine subtraction and radians are identical. Every non-display field is identical.

independentDecision.reviseRule: Any definite semantic drift requires REVISE.
independentDecision.basis: PASS follows direct inspection and strict original/current equality after removal of only the authorized layout tokens, not merely the existence of a previous PASS.
independentDecision.existingSubstantiveReview: The existing substantive PASS supplied by the task is reused; physics, source and choice correctness were not re-reviewed or independently re-established.

limits: Only the supplied original backup and current answer-key JSON were read as review inputs.
Scope is solely semantic preservation of seven display-math layout changes in answers 2, 3 and 4, plus identity of answer 1 and all other fields.
No physics recalculation, source review, choice review, image opening, browser use, rendering assessment, database access, network access, Git operation or paid call.
